# Which-key hints (key-sequence-hints, on by default): after a sequence's
# first key, what can follow is listed, then put away when it's over.
key:ctrl+b
wait:0.6
expect-key-hints:V Split Right
expect-key-hints:C New Tab
expect-pending-keys:⌃B …
key:escape
wait:0.3
expect-key-hints:-
expect-pending-keys:-
# Pressed quickly, the sequence never shows it.
key:ctrl+b
key:v
wait:0.6
expect-key-hints:-
expect-panes:2
